sections.title: Problem framing: the stressful emergency room experience

The speaker attributes a growth advantage to these deliberate actions (three times faster growth than other Connecticut hospitals).
sections.title: Deliberate actions and outcomes: specific parking/entry improvements

summary: In this brief talk, Jeanne Bliss uses Griffin Hospital as a case study to illustrate how a healthcare provider can deliberately design the patient and family experience around the life and emotions of the customer. The speaker contrasts Griffin Hospital’s past reputation for poor processes with a redesign that begins by understanding the mom’s perspective and the emotional journey from frantic to calm. The turnaround hinges on concrete, front-line-focused actions in the parking and entry experience—such as ambient music, valet parking, and concierge support—that signal welcome and reduce anxiety. The result, the speaker notes, is a measurable improvement in performance, with the hospital reportedly growing much faster than peers in Connecticut.
title: Griffin Hospital’s Deliberate Patient Experience Design: Moving from Frantic to Calm
topics: emotional journey mapping in service design
